See also: familia, Familia, famìlia, and familią

Catalan

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Latin familia.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): (Central, Balearic) [fəˈmi.li.ə]
  • IPA(key): (Valencia) [faˈmi.li.a]
  • Audio (Catalonia):(file)

Noun

[edit]

família f (plural famílies)

  1. family

Related terms

[edit]
  • familiar

Further reading

[edit]
  • “família”, in Diccionari de la llengua catalana [Dictionary of the Catalan Language] (in Catalan), second edition, Institute of Catalan Studies [Catalan: Institut d'Estudis Catalans], April 2007

Galician

[edit]

Noun

[edit]

família f (plural famílias, reintegrationist norm)

  1. reintegrationist spelling of familia

Further reading

[edit]
  • “família”, in Dicionário Estraviz de galego (in Galician), 2014–2026

Hungarian

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [ˈfɒmiːlijɒ]
  • Hyphenation: fa‧mí‧lia
  • Rhymes: -jɒ

Noun

[edit]

família (plural famíliák)

  1. (literary or humorous) family
    Synonym: család

Occitan

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • familha (Gascony, Limousin, Provençal)

Etymology

[edit]

From Latin familia.

Noun

[edit]

família f (plural famílias) (Languedoc)

  1. family

Related terms

[edit]
  • familial
  • familiar

Further reading

[edit]
  • Diccionari General de la Lenga Occitana‎[1], L’Academia occitana – Consistòri del Gai Saber, 2008-2025, page 313

Portuguese

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • familha (obsolete, now eye dialect or misspelling)
  • familia (obsolete)

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Latin familia (“household, family”).

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /faˈmi.li.ɐ/ [faˈmi.lɪ.ɐ], (faster pronunciation) /faˈmi.ljɐ/
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /faˈmi.li.ɐ/ [faˈmi.lɪ.ɐ], (faster pronunciation) /faˈmi.ljɐ/
    • (Southern Brazil) IPA(key): /faˈmi.li.a/ [faˈmi.lɪ.a], (faster pronunciation) /faˈmi.lja/
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /fɐˈmi.ljɐ/

  • (Northeast Brazil) IPA(key): /fɐˈmi.lja/
  • Audio:(file)
  • Audio (Portugal (Porto)):(file)
  • Hyphenation: fa‧mí‧lia

Noun

[edit]

família f (plural famílias)

  1. family; nuclear family (a father, mother and their sons and daughters)
  2. family; bloodline; kin
    Synonym: linhagem
  3. (taxonomy) family
  4. (linguistics) language family
  5. things which are classed together
    Synonym: agrupamento
  6. a Mafia family

Derived terms

[edit]
  • familinha (diminutive)

Related terms

[edit]
  • antifamília
  • Bolsa Família
  • familial
  • familiar
  • familiaridade
  • familiarizado
  • familiarizar
